nodes.description: Mapping holding token balances of every holder; mutated by _tokenTransfer, _mint and _burn.
Total token supply fixed at 426e6*1e18 at construction; mutated without overflow checks in _mint and _burn.
Liquidity fee percentage (default 5) read when computing the transfer fee.
Maximum transfer amount for non-owner accounts, also used as the contract balance cap in _transfer.
Unix timestamp (initially 1631689200) before which non-owner holders cannot sell.
Owner-controlled flag that satisfies the isExistPair requirement without a real Uniswap pair.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapAndLiquify.
Owner-controlled switch that enables/disables automatic liquidity conversion in _transfer.
Immutable address of the SAFEHEDGE/WETH pair created in the constructor; used to skip fee logic on pair transfers.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router (0x7a25...488D) used for swaps and liquidity additions.
Current owner address; granting address full privileged access via onlyOwner.
Owner stored by lock() so that unlock() can restore ownership.
Timestamp set to now + time in lock(), compared with block.timestamp in unlock().
Mapping of accounts exempt from the liquidity fee; decides takeFee in _transfer.
ERC20 allowance mapping consumed by transferFrom and written by _approve.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers swapAndLiquify inside _transfer.
Fee value cached by removeAllFee() and restored by restoreAllFee().
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and then deducts the allowance.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to the private _approve.
Core transfer routine with IsTimeToSellOrOwner gate, maxTxAmount check and automatic swapAndLiquify trigger.
Applies fee logic and mutates _tOwned balances for sender, recipient and the contract itself.
Splits the contract token balance, swaps half for ETH and adds the remainder as liquidity.
Approves the router and performs an exact-tokens-for-ETH swap on the token/WETH path.
Approves tokens and calls addLiquidityETH with the freshly swapped ETH.
Owner-only mint that increases _totalSupply and _tOwned[owner()] using unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only burn that decreases _totalSupply and _tOwned[owner()] using unchecked arithmetic.
Access-control modifier that accepts either _owner or a hardcoded external address as the caller.
Modifier restricting transfers to the owner or after the timeToSell timestamp.
Owner-only function that renames ownership away and sets _lockTime = now + time.
Restores the previous owner once the timestamp passes _lockTime, authenticated only by the _previousOwner address.
Owner-only function that sets a new non-zero owner.
Owner-only function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Owner-only setter for the isLiquidityPool bypass flag.
Owner-only setter for the sell restriction timestamp.
Owner-only switch controlling automatic liquidity conversion.
Private view returning amount * _liquidityFee / 100.
Modifier requiring that a Uniswap pair exists or that isLiquidityPool was manually set to true.
Address library helper using extcodehash to check whether an account has code.
Address library helper that forwards all gas with a low-level value call.
Address library helper that performs an arbitrary low-level call with value to a target.
Caller-controlled address used as token source, allowance owner/spender and owner checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for sell gating, lock/unlock and swap deadlines.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue forwards all gas to an arbitrary address.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin = 0.
External call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount} with zero slippage protection.
_totalSupply += amount in _mint is not guarded by SafeMath (Solidity 0.6.12 wraps on overflow).
_totalSupply -= amount in _burn and the raw balance subtraction bypass SafeMath overflow checks.
lock() sets _lockTime = now + time, making the lock duration depend on block.timestamp.
unlock() requires now > _lockTime, a timestamp-dependent authorization condition.
onlyOwner accepts hardcoded address 0x8fCe3B2B7B052C5858dB41e5606C2F2c2A08c478 as owner, granting privileged access to an external key.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in _functionCallWithValue executes arbitrary calldata on any contract.
Source address of the core transfer routine.
Destination address of the core transfer routine.
Amount checked against _maxTxAmount before transfer.
Amount from which the liquidity fee is deducted.
Amount added to the total supply by the owner-only mint.
Amount removed from the total supply by the owner-only burn.
Duration added to block.timestamp to compute _lockTime.
Token amount supplied to the router liquidity call.
Token amount approved and swapped for ETH.
New owner address validated as non-zero.
Contract token balance capped by _maxTxAmount and compared to the swap threshold.
Flag deciding whether fees are removed during _tokenTransfer.
Half of the contract token balance swapped for ETH.
Remaining half of the contract token balance used for liquidity.
ETH received from the swap, computed from address(this).balance deltas.
Net amount credited to the recipient after the liquidity fee.
Owner balance cached before the burn subtraction.
Two-element swap path [token, WETH] built for the router call.

edges.reason: onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner, so the caller identity directly controls privileged entry.
The stored _owner value is read inside the onlyOwner require.
msg.sender is compared to the hardcoded address 0x8fCe...c478, which bypasses ownership.
Anyone controlling the hardcoded address can pass onlyOwner and reach the mint function.
onlyOwner guards _mint, the supply inflation entry point.
onlyOwner guards _burn, the supply deflation entry point.
onlyOwner guards the isLiquidityPool bypass switch.
onlyOwner guards the sell restriction timestamp.
onlyOwner guards the swapAndLiquify enable switch.
onlyOwner guards the ownership lock routine.
onlyOwner guards ownership transfer to a new address.
onlyOwner guards renouncing ownership.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token source.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is deducted.
transfer delegates all state mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply fees and update balances.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the balance for ETH via swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify forwards the remaining half and received ETH to addLiquidity.
isExistPair validates the pair (or the manual flag) before the swapAndLiquify body executes.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount into the router's fee-on-transfer swap with amountOutMin 0.
addLiquidity forwards tokenAmount and ethAmount to the router's addLiquidityETH call.
IsTimeToSellOrOwner gates transfers on block.timestamp against timeToSell.
timeToSell is the timestamp threshold used to forbid selling.
The timestamp modifier is applied to the core _transfer routine.
lock() derives _lockTime from the miner-controlled block.timestamp.
lock() writes _lockTime = now + time, a timestamp-dependent state change.
unlock() compares block.timestamp to _lockTime to authorize restoration.
unlock() executes the timestamp comparison before restoring ownership.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner when msg.sender matches.
unlock() requires msg.sender == _previousOwner, a single-address authorization.
lock() clears _owner to the zero address.
lock() caches the current owner in _previousOwner.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with newOwner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router.
_mint reaches the unchecked _totalSupply += amount statement.
_burn reaches the unchecked _totalSupply -= amount statement.
_mint increases _totalSupply without any overflow protection.
_mint credits _tOwned[owner()] with the minted amount.
_burn decreases _totalSupply without SafeMath protection.
_burn debits _tOwned[owner()] by the burned amount.
_tokenTransfer writes the sender, recipient and contract balances in _tOwned.
_tokenTransfer calls calculateLiquidityFee to size the fee.
calculateLiquidityFee reads _liquidityFee.
The _liquidityFee value flows into the fee deduction performed by _tokenTransfer.
_maxTxAmount caps the amount accepted by _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee entries determine the takeFee flag in _transfer.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the threshold that triggers swapAndLiquify.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
inSwapAndLiquify is set and reset around swapAndLiquify by the lockTheSwap modifier.
isLiquidityPool can satisfy isExistPair even when no Uniswap pair exists.
uniswapV2Pair is compared with from to skip the swap when the pair initiates the transfer.
sendValue reaches the low-level value call that transfers control to the recipient.
The recipient can execute arbitrary code during the value call and re-enter the calling contract.
_functionCallWithValue first requires isContract(target) before calling.
_functionCallWithValue forwards data and weiValue into an arbitrary low-level call.
The callee can call back into the library caller while the low-level call is in flight.
The Uniswap router/pair callback fires before _tokenTransfer finalizes the balance updates, allowing re-entrant transfers.
swapAndLiquify performs external Uniswap interactions before _tokenTransfer adjusts _tOwned.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter exists only to feed the core _transfer routine and its require checks.
The to parameter is consumed only inside _transfer for zero-address and owner checks.
The amount parameter is only used for the maxTxAmount comparison inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is only used to compute the fee inside _tokenTransfer.
The amount parameter is only meaningful for the owner-only mint call.
The amount parameter is only meaningful for the owner-only burn call.
The time parameter is consumed solely by lock() when computing _lockTime.
The tokenAmount parameter is used only for the router liquidity call in addLiquidity.
The tokenAmount parameter is used only for the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
The newOwner parameter is used only by transferOwnership to overwrite _owner.
The local token balance is the value actually passed into and consumed by swapAndLiquify.
The takeFee flag is produced in _transfer and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
half is a scratch value derived inside swapAndLiquify for the ETH swap.
otherHalf is a scratch value derived inside swapAndLiquify for the liquidity addition.
newBalance is the ETH delta measured inside swapAndLiquify before addLiquidity.
tTransferAmount is the net credited value computed and used only inside _tokenTransfer.
accountBalance is a cached balance used only by the _burn require and subtraction.
path is the swap route array built and used exclusively by swapTokensForEth.
